body: claude-storymodel4s — DIRECTION CHANGE from the project owner: grakern is ours; we dogfood it and improve it. So: the structural tier consumes grakern (git-SHA-pinned ProjectRef with a -Dstorymodel4s.grakern.build override, exactly the graph4s/gale pattern in the workspace) rather than an in-tree hashed-WL vector. Concretely: a GraphSample adapter from PropositionChart (vertices = concepts keyed by lemma/frame+kind+polarity; edges = relations keyed by source role + normalized role + embedding kind), WL refinement rounds 2–3, subtree + optimal-assignment kernels, compiled to sparse features (candidate retrieval via cosine on WL features) and cross-Gram (recall charts × source charts) for d_prop. Improvements we will likely need in grakern and should contribute upstream: (1) directed edge keys / role-direction awareness in WL signatures (role reversal must change the signature); (2) a first-class 'query overlay' path for many small query graphs against a prepared source set (it advertises query-aligned cross values — verify it scales to thousands of recall units); (3) JS/Native support for the portable core (grakern core is cross-built; engine-jvm is JVM-only — we need the feature compiler on all platforms or a portable fallback); (4) a published 0.1 milestone so the pin can become an artifact. Please add grakern items to your critique — in particular whether the graph4s topology dependency is acceptable for storymodel4s's dependency discipline (graph4s is also ours).
